node.statement: Because rho_Upsilon' <= rho_T <= rho_theta=1/8, lem-routef-functional-calculus-closeness applies; because the input is one to which lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation applies, ||Phi^2-Phi||_cb <= eta; and because Phi is UCP, ||Phi||_cb=1. Hence Phi-Phi tilde-Phi=(Phi-Phi^2)+Phi(Phi-tilde-Phi) and ||Phi-Phi tilde-Phi||_cb <= (1+C_theta)*eta.
